# scip-dotnet producer correction

This directory carries a reviewed patch for the external C#/Visual Basic SCIP
producer, based on Sourcegraph `scip-dotnet` v0.2.14, commit
`3e1f671e65692f517b0d35521fd1951c63939e3c`. It preserves the upstream
`scip-dotnet index` CLI. Graphit's dispatcher and qualification orchestration
are Rust. No SCIP output rewriting or vendor fallback is involved.

`upstream.json` is the provenance receipt: immutable archive URL/checksum,
patch checksum, upstream/patched source checksums, SDK image digests, local
package version and protocol generator. `fix-symbol-origins.patch` applies
with `patch --batch --fuzz=0 -p1` to that exact extracted archive. The Docker
recipe verifies the archive and patch checksums before applying it.

The patch gives namespaces their full ancestry, obtains declaration symbols
from Roslyn and classifies actual source/metadata origins independently of
package-prefix text. Source namespaces, including namespaces merged with BCL
metadata, retain declaration information in source documents. Metadata-only
merged namespaces without an assembly use the existing unknown-package
representation only after all constituents are proven external. Concrete
types retain their own assembly package. Global namespace roots produce no
empty descriptor. Named types use their actual CLR metadata arity; non-ASCII
identifiers and embedded backticks use SCIP escaping.

Information for emitted references and relationship targets comes from the
real Roslyn symbol/documentation. Implicit constructors retain definition
relationships to real declaring types. C#14 contextual `field` references bind
to the actual Roslyn implicit field and its associated property definition;
the keyword is never emitted as a fabricated declaration. The collector does not recursively
expand the BCL. Compiler errors, restore failure/timeout and MSBuild workspace
failures cannot publish a successful index. The emitted tool version is
`0.2.14-graphit.2`.

All documents explicitly declare UTF-16 code-unit offsets using the exact
SCIP v0.10 `Document.position_encoding = 6` field and enum value `2`. These
minimal protocol additions preserve the upstream wire field numbers. The
checked patch contains C# bindings regenerated by the pinned `protoc`
recorded in the receipt. Google.Protobuf 3.30.0 and MSBuildLocator 1.7.8 retain upstream pins. All
Roslyn packages use the coherent 5.9.0 generation; ConfigurationManager is
10.0.1, the minimum required by that generation.

The image's vendor stage uses the pinned official SDK 10.0.401 image and packs
only `net10.0`, in Release, as `0.2.14-graphit.2`. Installation in the same pinned
SDK 10 image uses `NuGet.Config`, which clears all feeds and enables only
`/vendorfeed`; the target framework, package version and tool path are explicit.
The installed net10 tool has been exercised with only runtime 10.0.12 present.
The source-built netcore BuildHost targets net10, with its complete companions
and explicit public Task/targets binding. The stock net472 assets remain intact.

The source-built compiler task publishes each original argument in opaque item
metadata; the BuildHost requires that metadata. The modern VB fixture exercises
escaped conditional constants; the C# fixture covers contextual field references.

Run the maintained smoke test with:

```console
cargo run --locked --bin xtask -- vendor-dotnet-smoke
```

It builds with normal Docker caching and exercises the original and modern C#/VB
corpus through the real dispatcher, then checks decoded indexes with the official
SCIP CLI. To test an existing image, use `vendor-dotnet-corpus <sha256:imageID>`.
The [validation guide](../../docs/scip-dotnet-vendor.md) describes prerequisites
and coverage. Generated logs, packages and SDK diagnostic probes are not source
dependencies. Immutable source/patch provenance remains in `upstream.json`.
